top_signals.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
top_signals.summary: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Record deployment for destroyer USS Spruance casts doubt over US Navy maintenance
top_signals.summary: The Arleigh-Burke class destroyer USS Spruance has set a post-World War II record for a U.S. Navy destroyer deployment and is raising questions about the maintenance work that could follow its eventual return.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: What we know about the $6.3bn Binance hack
top_signals.summary: Analysis suggests hackers bypassed standard methods used in crypto thefts
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Reddit stock plunges 30% after weak outlook, heads for worst day ever
top_signals.summary: Reddit shares sank on Friday after the company issued weak Q4 sales guidance and announced it will test requiring users to log in to see content.
